headline: City council approves new metro line connecting airport to downtown
text: The city council on Tuesday approved a new metro line that will connect the international airport to downtown. Construction is expected to begin next year and finish within six years. Officials said the project will cut travel time to 25 minutes. The line will cost an estimated 40 billion rupees.

headline: Local team wins national robotics championship in Pune
text: A team of college students from Delhi won the national robotics championship held in Pune on Sunday. The team built a robot that can sort waste using computer vision. Judges praised the design for its low cost. The students will now represent India at the world finals in Singapore.

headline: Heavy rain disrupts flights and trains across northern India
text: Heavy rain on Monday disrupted flights and train services across northern India. More than 60 flights were delayed at Delhi airport and several trains were cancelled. The weather department has issued a yellow alert for the next two days. Authorities have asked residents to avoid unnecessary travel.

headline: Government launches free online coding courses for school students
text: The education ministry has launched free online coding courses for school students from class six onwards. The courses are available in eight regional languages. Students can register through the official portal. Officials said one million students are expected to enrol in the first year.

headline: Scientists discover new species of frog in Western Ghats
text: Researchers have discovered a new species of frog in the Western Ghats after a three year survey. The tiny frog is found only in a single forest stream. Scientists said the discovery highlights the need to protect the region. The findings were published in an international journal.

headline: Stock market closes higher as banking shares rally
text: The Sensex closed 400 points higher on Friday as banking shares rallied. Investors were encouraged by strong quarterly results from two large private banks. The broader Nifty also ended in positive territory. Analysts expect the trend to continue if global markets remain stable.

headline: Health ministry issues advisory ahead of winter flu season
text: The health ministry has issued an advisory to all states ahead of the winter flu season. People above 60 years and those with chronic illness are urged to get vaccinated. Hospitals have been asked to keep adequate stocks of medicines. The ministry also advised citizens to wear masks in crowded places.

headline: Delhi University announces new four year undergraduate schedule
text: Delhi University has announced the academic schedule for the new four year undergraduate programme. Classes for first year students will begin in August. Admissions will be based on entrance test scores. The university said the calendar will be shared on its website this week.

headline: Electric vehicle sales double in the last financial year
text: Sales of electric vehicles have doubled in the last financial year according to industry data. Two wheelers made up the largest share of the sales. Government subsidies and falling battery prices helped the growth. Experts say charging infrastructure remains the biggest challenge.

headline: Farmers protest low prices outside district office in Punjab
text: Hundreds of farmers gathered outside the district office in Punjab on Wednesday to protest low crop prices. They demanded a higher minimum support price for wheat. Officials met a delegation of the farmers in the evening. The protest ended after the administration promised to forward their demands.
